name: The Ruins
flavor: What's left isn't a house or a hall. It's shelving that forgot to stop.

beats.title: Shelving, Not a House
beats.body: What's left isn't a house or a hall — it's shelving, room after room of it, stone rows still standing in some places, collapsed into rubble in others. Even the rubble looks like it fell in a pattern.

beats.title: The Directory
beats.body: A surviving wall has a carved directory of some kind — location names and numbers, clearly a system, completely undecipherable now. One line has been scratched out hard enough to gouge the stone.

beats.title: Four Doors, All Shut
beats.body: A chamber deep in that must once have connected to at least four other rooms — archways in every wall — and every archway is bricked shut from this side, not the other.

beats.title: Someone's Been Digging
beats.body: A patch of rubble has been cleared recently. Tool marks, a stacked pile of stones set aside deliberately. Grounds crew swears it isn't them. Nobody's filed a report either way.
